# Shield Point Strategies

> Safety, security and emergency-preparedness consulting based in Liberty Lake, Washington, serving Eastern Washington and North Idaho. Led by Brian Asmus, retired Chief of Police of Liberty Lake, Washington. Preparedness · Planning · Protection.

Shield Point Strategies helps schools, churches, non-profits, businesses and public agencies understand their risks, plan for an emergency, and train their people. Every engagement starts with a conversation and a walk through the place. Prices are given on request.

## Services
- [Security & Safety Assessments](https://shieldpoint.training/services/security-assessments/): A full walk of your site with a chief's eyes, and a written report you can act on.
- [Emergency Operations Planning](https://shieldpoint.training/services/emergency-planning/): Plans people can run from memory, built for your building and your people.
- [Training](https://shieldpoint.training/services/training/): For staff, leadership, boards and volunteers — what to notice, what to do, what to say. Plus firearms training from beginner to advanced.
- [Executive Protection](https://shieldpoint.training/services/executive-protection/): Armed and unarmed executive protection, led by a career police chief with thirty years in law enforcement.
- [Law Enforcement & Public-Agency Consulting](https://shieldpoint.training/services/agency-consulting/): Twenty years running a department, offered to yours.

## About
- [About Brian Asmus](https://shieldpoint.training/about/): his law-enforcement record and public service.
- [The five layers](https://shieldpoint.training/approach/): Deter, Detect, Delay, Respond, Recover.
- [Readiness check](https://shieldpoint.training/readiness/): ten questions that show where a place stands.
- [Safe Places directory](https://shieldpoint.training/directory/): schools, churches, clinics, non-profits, agencies and businesses in Eastern Washington and North Idaho, by town.
